text:
Maya: kicking off a small canary for service-token fallback telemetry at 11:30 PST. goal: surface fallbacks in the console and tie them back to rollouts. who volunteers to own the dashboard work?

Alex: i can do a quick panel. what metric should i use — we've got a couple names floating around in prometheus.

Maya: standardize on auth_token_fallback_total. emit labels: reason (quota|latency|unavailable), route_variant (primary|fallback), org_id, project_id when available, origin_hint, quota_bucket. for high-card orgs emit sampled_project_id instead of full project to limit cardinality.

Sam: are we guaranteed to have org_id on older service tokens? some legacy tokens aren't annotated. fallback should attribute to request origin when there's no project info.

Olga: +1 on attribution rule. also: panel needs a way to collapse by top orgs only, otherwise grafana explodes.

Maya: yep — telemetry will add sampled_project_id for top-10 orgs and leave it empty for others. ingestion side will run an enrichment lookup to backfill org/project within ~5m. document the lag.

Alex: plan: two panels — (1) global fallback rate (per minute) (2) top 15 orgs by fallback count using sampled_project_id; include stacked breakdown by quota_bucket. i'll add a prometheus variable for quota_bucket so PMs can filter.

Ken: small ops ask: can the console rollout UI annotate which service accounts were routed to fallback so SRE can jump to rollout details? linking from the dashboard rows to rollout would be ideal.

Maya: we can add a shortlink like /console/rollouts/:id/insights. the dashboard rows will include rollout_id when the request originated from a rollout.

Tom: privacy note: do not display raw SA names on public dashboards. use hashed_sa_id; allow reveal in the incident view for prod-only roles.

Olga: agreed. add label hashed_sa_id and show full name only behind click-to-reveal in the runbook step.

Sam: how will proxy surface a fallback? dedicated header? response code?

Maya: auth-proxy will set header X-Auth-Fallback: reason=quota (or latency|unavailable). it will also emit the prometheus increment with corresponding labels.

Alex: sample query i'll wire into grafana: 
```
sum by (org_id) (increase(auth_token_fallback_total{route_variant="fallback"}[5m]))
```
for the stacked view i'll use label_join to combine org_id and quota_bucket.

infra-bot: infra-bot deployed auth-proxy v2.11.0 canary to infra-canary at 2024-03-20T18:30:10Z :rocket:

Maya: thanks infra-bot — watching first 30m. alert thresholds: >50% above baseline for 10m should page. set temporary PD to infra on-call.

Sam: adding ephemeral alert rule fallback_rate_anomaly_canary — fires when rate > baseline*1.5 for 10m. i'll tag it with canary_id=svc-fb-2024-03-20.

Olga: put telemetry tag canary_id=svc-fb-2024-03-20 on metrics and the search query so we can filter. also update monitoring runbook with step to unmask hashed_sa_id.

Alex: PR opened with panels + link to rollout details + hashed_sa_id: https://stash.redwood/example/PR-4728 — needs review.

Maya: product note from Tom: please expose quota_bucket as a prometheus variable in console so PMs can quickly filter.

Alex: added the prometheus variable to the dashboard. also added a hover tooltip explaining sampled_project_id vs project_id and the 5m enrichment lag.

Ken: rollout plan: promote after 4h of stable metrics. abort if any org has >5% of traffic routed to fallback for more than 15m.

Maya: noted. will post summaries to #incidents if thresholds are hit.

Alex: merged dashboard PR. verified graphs against test orgs — looks sane.

Sam: telemetry caveat: ingestion backfill job runs every 5m, so dashboards can lag for newly seen orgs/projects. adding that to rollout_notes.md.

Maya: added rollout_notes.md snippet: "org/project enrichment is eventual (<=5m). for realtime ops use sampled_project_id."

Olga: SRE done — runbook updated with hashed_sa_id unmask step and link to rollout insights.

Maya: canary completed after +4h, metrics stable. promoting to 20% traffic now. will coordinate full rollout in tomorrow morning sync. thanks all :heart:
